periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Placed prevention and treatment racks at nine locations, including five library branches and the Community Health Center. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add racks at both urgent care clinics and the remaining library branches, with QR codes to the directory.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added racks at both urgent care clinics and the remaining library branches, bringing locations to 15, and printed directory QR codes on every rack. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Place racks at the airport family waiting room and other high-traffic sites, and set a monthly refill schedule.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Resource racks are now in 22 locations, including all library branches, both urgent care clinics and the airport family waiting room. QR codes link to the directory, and staff refill each rack monthly. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add racks at laundromats and corner stores in Harbor Creek and track which brochures run out first.
